assumptions.claim: Parameter WidthPRDSBox must be greater than 8 for the declaration of unused_prd_msbs to be valid; otherwise the range (WidthPRDSBox-8)-1:0 is illegal.
assumptions.cond: Whenever WidthPRDSBox is used as a compile-time constant and this chunk is instantiated.
assumptions.risk: Compilation or synthesis failure, or a silent zero-width tie-off that may hide unintended masking behavior.

assumptions.claim: CiphOpFwdOnly is a compile-time parameter that selects forward-only mode (1) or encryption/decryption mode (0), and the generate blocks rely on its constant value.
assumptions.risk: If CiphOpFwdOnly is not a compile constant, generate condition fails; if misconfigured, unused key mix columns out may be asserted/disconnected incorrectly.

assumptions.claim: The parameter WidthPRDMasking is defined and non-negative; the declaration unused_prd_masking has width WidthPRDMasking-1:0.
assumptions.cond: When the generate block gen_unused_key_mix_columns_out is active (CiphOpFwdOnly=1).
assumptions.risk: If WidthPRDMasking is negative or undefined, compilation error; a zero-width tie-off is legal but may mask intent.

uncertain_points.claim: The signal unused_prd_msbs ties off the MSBs above bit 7 of the PRD per S-box (dimensions 4x4). This suggests only 8 bits per S-box masking byte are used. If the masking scheme expects wider entropy, ignoring upper bits may reduce side-channel resistance.
uncertain_points.cond: When PRD masking width is greater than 8 bits per S-box.
uncertain_points.risk: Side-channel leakage if mask entropy is discarded; functional masking may be insufficient.

uncertain_points.claim: The generate block gen_key_dec (enabled when !CiphOpFwdOnly) contains the key expansion logic for decryption. Its content is not included in this chunk and must be reviewed to ensure correct and secure inverse key schedule.
uncertain_points.cond: When the core is configured for encryption+decryption mode (CiphOpFwdOnly=0).
uncertain_points.risk: A bug in key decryption logic could leak key material or produce incorrect ciphertext, breaking confidentiality.
